# PIXZ.DEV Skills — Map for LLMs

> 28 portable skills for Claude, OpenClaw, OpenCode, Hermes. Source ≠ install.

## Identity
- Repo: https://github.com/pixzdev/skills
- Version: 1.0.1 (VERSION file; registry.json)
- Entry: AGENTS.md (agent registry) / README.md (human) / registry.json (machine)

## Install (not clone)
- Matrix: docs/install/README.md
- Agent prompt (copy-paste): docs/install-as-skill.md
- Full runtime-adaptive prompt: docs/prompts/install-skill-agent.md
- CLI: npx skills add pixzdev/skills --skill <folder> (skills.sh, VERIFIED)
- Claude: ~/.claude/skills/ or .claude/skills/ (VERIFIED)
- OpenClaw: openclaw skills install (VERIFIED)
- OpenCode: .opencode/skill/ (VERIFIED)
- Hermes: ~/.hermes/skills/ (VERIFIED)

## Registry / Discovery
- AGENTS.md (projection) ; registry.json (source) ; */AGENTS.md (nav)
- Schemas: schemas/skill.schema.json, registry.schema.json, workflow.schema.json, eval.schema.json
- Discovery: scan AGENTS.md trigger table → registry.json → <path>/SKILL.md

## Architecture
- docs/architecture.md (core → adapter, workflow state vs methodological)
- docs/dependency-model.md (requires/aggregates/optional opt-in/conflicts, limits 15/6/8)
- docs/architecture/routing.md (task→skill routing, under/over, circular safety mitigation)
- docs/taxonomy.md (7 criteria, merged concepts)
- docs/versioning.md (latest/stable VERIFIED, pinned future)

## Limitations (honest)
- pinned channel: DOCUMENTED ONLY (no pixz.lock)
- behavioral eval: PARTIALLY VERIFIED (heuristic smoke)
- generic runtime: PARTIALLY VERIFIED (spec, no CI smoke)
- needs npx (Node 18+) or manual cp -r

## Verification
- docs/evaluation.md (4 layers: structural / documentary / behavioral / integration)
- Scripts: scripts/validate.py, check-cycles.py, resolve.py, integration-smoke.sh
- Evals: evals/cases/, evals/behavioral/
